name: Sound Wizard (for phone)
description: An audio analyser and tone generator for the phone, fast enough to keep up with real sound, in two rooms. Sound: level meter (A, C, flat), spectrogram up to FFT 32768, triggered oscilloscope, and a room tool (sweep or clap: frequency response, reverberation time per octave band, low resonances). Musician: a tuner that finds any note or follows 16 tunings or your own, with an intonation trainer for scales (equal or just, with a log of your notes); tone analysis (note, chord, key); rhythm analysis with polyrhythm detection and suggested notation; and practice mode: a metronome with accents, subdivisions and polyrhythm layers, and a timing report (early or late in ms, evenness, drift, swing). A note or frequency generator (sine, triangle, square, saw) is always at hand in the top bar. Installable, full screen, works offline; nothing is recorded or sent.
